best_idea: Store only the server-confirmed input stream plus the match seed and pre-match time, then replay a fight by feeding those inputs back through the same engine, so a stored bout is re-run rather than re-recorded.
decision_why: The record-inputs-not-state shape fits Pit replays as content and the server-verified kill ledger, but it works only if the fight sim is fully deterministic from seed plus inputs, and Frankendom must refuse to replay across a gap (the donor zero-pads).
acceptance: A server test re-runs a recorded 60-second duel from its stored seed and input log and asserts the same final HP, kill ledger and tick count as the live fight; a Pit viewer opening a stored bout sees the same result.
